_comment: Event trigger definitions — data-driven dispatch for Game.triggerEvent(). New events are data-only additions: define here, implement the handler method in game.js, done. (Steve 2026-10-07)

events.description: SYSTEM CHALLENGE: Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!
events.name: First Hunt Challenge

events.description: A stranger walks into Haven. They're thin, scared, and carrying nothing.
events.name: Stranger at Haven

events.description: HOWLS in the distance. Closer than before.
events.name: Hushwolf Pack

events.description: SYSTEM QUEST: Teach us? Show us a plant you've fully identified (Codex L3).
events.name: System Quest

events.description: INCOMING: A fan sent you a care package. Contents: one rubber duck, three hair ties, and a note reading 'FOR LUCK.' The System adds, helpfully: 'We checked. It is not dinner.' (Opening it takes a day-part. The fans are watching.)
events.name: Fan Care Package

events.description: The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath, and something out there knows exactly where you sleep. (Investigating costs a day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing.)
events.name: The Quiet Woods

events.description: SYSTEM QUEST: 'We have studied cooking. Step one: apply heat until food stops being food? No - wait. We had it. Teach us? Show us one cooked meal, start to finish.' (The demonstration takes a day-part and 300 kcal of tubers. The System WILL take notes.)
events.name: System Cooking Lesson

events.description: A trader from the downriver village walks into Haven, pack heavy, smile practiced. They have news - some of it might even be true. (Feeding a guest costs about 600 kcal. Trading takes a day-part. Rudeness is free, but the river remembers.)
events.name: River Trader

events.description: SYSTEM CHALLENGE: 'We have designed a trial JUST for you. Based on our observations. Which are extensive. And flattering.' (Trials take a full day-part and leave you drained. Pick 1 of 3.)
events.name: Trial of the System

events.description: The sky to the west has gone the color of a bruise. The old-timers are already tying things down. A storm is coming, and it does not care about your plans. (Sheltering costs the dusk foraging window, a 400-800 kcal haul. Getting caught out costs more.)
events.name: Storm Front
